about_the_game:
In the demo version, you can play from the opening to 16 stages.

The time required to complete the game is estimated to be about 30 minutes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows7+
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Ryzen™ 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10+
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 or AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
